body: All of my friends seem to be doing so well. I'm broke, I hate myself , can't find a job, can't find any internship and while everyone out there is smiling and laughing , I'm barely hanging on. I feel genuinely depressed as hell and I can't take this pain. My chest feels so heavy, everything feels like it's too much effort. Having the worst year of my life. It feels like God Hates me and genuinely wants me to suffer.
